title.zh: Vanguard FAS 销售顾问智能体双路数据与人审治理架构（THR916）
title.en: Vanguard FAS Sales Advisor Assist Dual-Path & Human-Governed Architecture (THR916)

label.zh: 1. 对话统一前门与零管道工作上下文层（Conversational Front Door & Work IQ Grounding）
label.en: 1. Conversational Front Door & Zero-Plumbing Work Context (M365 Sales Agent & Work IQ)

label.zh: 2. 双路企业集成底座：CRM 业务技能路 vs. 多云信号路（CRM Path & Enterprise-Signals Path）
label.en: 2. Dual Integration Paths: Dataverse Business Skills (CRM) & Fabric IQ (FAS 360 Signals)

label.zh: 3. 全链路受监管信任护栏与系统回写层（Identity, Disambiguation & Human-Reviewed Write-Back）
label.en: 3. Regulated Trust Guardrails & Systems of Record (Identity, Policy & Human Confirmation)

label.zh: Vanguard FAS 销售代表（数百人全美展业）

detail.zh: 服务全美约 300,000 名外部理财顾问，告别跨系统人工拼图
detail.en: Serves ~300,000 external financial advisors without manual app-hopping

label.zh: Microsoft 365 Sales Agent（一方对话前门）

detail.zh: 将简短业务黑话展开为复合推理计划，呈现附带证据链的决策建议
detail.en: Expands shorthand asks into multi-source plans and cited decisions

label.zh: Work IQ：邮件、日历、聊天与会议转写纪要
label.en: Work IQ: Email, Calendar, Chats & Transcripts

detail.zh: 开箱自动挂载个人工作上下文，无需额外自建数据搬运管道
detail.en: Automatically grounds M365 activity with zero custom plumbing

label.zh: CRM 路：Business Skills（40+ 项）+ Dataverse MCP
label.en: CRM Path: 40+ Business Skills via Dataverse MCP

detail.zh: 注入 Vanguard 专属词汇表与业务规则，经 MCP 服务读写客户与商机
detail.en: Encodes Vanguard glossary and rules to read/write CRM via Dataverse MCP

label.zh: 信号路：自定义扩展 + Microsoft Fabric IQ
label.en: Signals Path: Custom Agent Extension + Fabric IQ

detail.zh: 桥接非微软生态外部数据湖，按线索分与时效拉取机构异动与推荐动作
detail.en: Bridges external multi-cloud signals into Sales Agent via custom extension

label.zh: FAS 360 多云数据湖与 Next Best Actions
label.en: FAS 360 Multi-Cloud Data Lake & Next Best Actions

detail.zh: 沉淀资金净流向、线索评分与确定性下一步最佳行动，拒绝对客临场编造
detail.en: Holds curated cash-flow shifts, lead scores, and deterministic NBA rules

label.zh: 委托身份与最小权限（Identity & Authorization）

detail.zh: 智能体仅能访问当前人类用户有权查看的数据，绝不越权执行任何操作
detail.en: Agent accesses and acts strictly within the logged-in user's permissions

label.zh: 歧义暂停核实与写入前人工审批弹窗
label.en: Ambiguity Pause & Human Review Before Write

detail.zh: 遇重名客户或重复商机主动追问；外发邮件与 CRM 回写必须经人工确认
detail.en: Pauses on duplicate records; zero emails sent or CRM writes without review

label.zh: 多业务线共享单实例 Dynamics 365 / Dataverse

detail.zh: 同时尊重后端与界面展示层双层校验规则，保持 Vanguard 唯一事实源
detail.en: Honors presentation- and data-layer validations across shared LOB apps
